headline: Singapore Crypto Economy Reaches $284 Billion on Institutional Inflows
summary: Chainalysis reported that Singapore's digital asset activity reached $284 billion, driven by a 94% jump in institutional participation.
why: Singapore functions as a leading financial and regulatory hub for digital assets in Asia, making its institutional adoption metrics a key gauge for the crypto sector.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency
impacts.why: Rising institutional transaction volumes signal growing capital deployment into regulated digital asset markets.
